title: invalidArguments used as a SetError in chat-00, Scene and VTC drafts
description: RFC 8620 defines invalidArguments only as a method-level error, not a SetError (RFC 8620 §5.3 SetError list). Drafts use it as a SetError in: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00.md L124 and L127 (tracked by jmap-chat-spec-g047); draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L656 (senderExpiresAt; crate-jmap returns invalidProperties) and L1732 (E2EE fields-inside-ciphertext rule); SetError tables in draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md and draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md (44 invalidArguments occurrences across the two; triage which are SetErrors vs method errors). Replace with invalidProperties (naming properties) or another RFC 8620 SetError. Related: jmap-chat-spec-y3rm (compliance 4.1 tooLarge vs ~L236 invalidArguments). Source: crate-jmap spec gap audit 2026-10-19.
notes:
Affects crate-jmap JMAP-y3f2.8 (senderExpiresAt), JMAP-8mem and JMAP-38uq SetError tables.
Mark 2026-10-20: chat-00 L657 past senderExpiresAt -> SetError invalidProperties [senderExpiresAt] (kit behaviour kept).
close_reason: Fixed in 91672c9 (spec: fix SetError codes, settle open conflicts), pushed.
